title: Depot logistics - loading-zone presence (content assignment)
business_line: Workers present in the loading zone
business_metric: Counted sustained presences in the loading zone, one per worker track
explanation: Measured: zone_occupancy - each tracked person whose box centre stays inside loading_zone (x 0.15-1.00, y 0.30-0.90) for at least 1.0 s. This is presence. It is NOT an entry count, NOT an exit count and NOT a dwell measurement: the event carries no duration and no direction. The specification's loading-zone entry and dwell rules are NOT computed: the engine has no entry-event kind and no dwell-event kind. The clip is a content assignment, not a proven scene fit.
scope_note: REDUCED SCOPE. Loading-zone entry and dwell are NOT delivered by this pack: zone_occupancy records a sustained presence and carries no duration and no direction, so neither an entry nor a dwell time is measured. What is measured is sustained presence of a worker in the loading zone. Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit.
content_assignment: Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit: worker-zone-detection shows workers walking through a marked industrial floor, not a dock door with vehicles loading.

zones.name: loading_zone
zones.measured: Measured with yolo11n-fp16 at 5 fps (conf 0.25, iou 0.45) over worker-zone-detection: person centroid x 0.204..0.977, y 0.345..0.792 (295 observations). The zone brackets that range; the left margin excludes the frame border and the upper margin excludes the ceiling/columns.

delivered_event: Delivered event: zone_occupancy - sustained presence in the loading zone. NOT an entry count. NOT a dwell measurement.
